answer: Each epoch, an agent must answer a challenge—like decoding a signed falcon-shaped nonce—and post onyx tokens as collateral; forged identities lose their bond. Sybil resistance here uses per-agent stake bonded to a unique hardware-rooted identity, so spinning up fake agents costs real capital. An agent caught running duplicate personas also burns a fable reputational record, making repeat attacks expensive. Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake identity, so mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
